12.t: Working with data: isomers of butane
q: Which isomer has the lower boiling point?
Same formula (C₄H₁₀), different arrangement of atoms.
Explain why the branched isomer boils at a lower temperature.
Branching makes the molecule more compact, with less contact between molecules: weaker forces between them.
The energies from burning are almost the same. Explain why.
Both contain the same atoms and bonds (C-C and C-H) and make the same products; only the shape differs.
